'''Cadro Borrigan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] businessman who owned a [[Restaurant/Legends|Restaurant]] in the [[Cultural District]] on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Cadro's restaurant was very upscale, and served some of the finest dishes on Ord Radama. There were also a collection of games such as [[Pazaak/Legends|Pazaak]] for the customers to play.<ref name="OoA1" />
